[span-p01-v02] Where this whole effect abides, and whence it has come forth — from being uncovered in form, there is no obstruction anywhere.

[span-p01-v03] Even in the difference of waking and the rest, it glides in the undifferent; the perceiver-ness never turns back from its own being.

[span-p01-v04] I happy, suffering, attached, and the like — those awarenesses plainly abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure-states.

[span-p01-v05] Where there is no suffering, no joy, no graspable, no grasper, and not even delusion — THAT is, ultimately.

[span-p01-v06] Since the sense-host, deluded, thinks itself undeluded — forthgoing, standing, dissolving, by the inner wheel.

[span-p02-v11] Regarding own nature as presiding, he abides as if smiling — whence his evil course?

[span-p02-v12] Non-being goes to be-becomeness, and there is no undelusion; since, from contact's application — then thus it was certain.

[span-p02-v13] Hence that made thing is to be known as ever like deep sleep; but not thus being-remembered does that reality attain.

[span-p03-v14] State-pair, called effect-doer-ness; effect-ness waning there, doer-ness again unwaning.

[span-p03-v15] Whatever mere effort faces effect is lost here; when lost, 'I am utterly lost' — so the unwise holds.

[span-p03-v16] But who inward-facing, seat of all-knowingness: his loss never ever, from not perceiving other.

[span-p03-v17] His perception ever, unfailing in three states; ever may it be of the fully awake — at beginning and end, but of the other.

[span-p03-v18] Whose form is knowing and knowable, yoked by supreme power: in two states the pervader shines, elsewhere consciousness-made.

[span-p03-v19] Spanda-flows beginning with qualities, from resting in common spanda — who got self-getting ever may they be, of the unopposed knower.

[span-p04-v20] Of unawakened minds, eager to cover self-standing — they cast down on the hard-to-cross, terrible wandering road.

[span-p04-v21] Hence ever striving for spanda-reality discerning: waking indeed, the own state soon attains.

[span-p04-v22] Angry, thrilled, or what shall I do — or pondering, running: whatever step it takes, there spanda is established.

[span-p04-v23] Which state seized, whatever this one tells me — that I will do: thus resolved, he stands.

[span-p04-v24] Her, by resorting to the upper path, moon and sun both — in suṣumnā set, brahma-egg-range left.

[span-p04-v25] Then in that great sky, moon and sun dissolved — like deep-sleep: deluded or awakened may be uncovered.
